name: Inferno · Lightning
primary:
A widening stream (up to 3 blocks wide) hits everyone in front of you; in instant mode it keeps going while held:
• Damage 8.5 ❤ fire + 3 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 43.2 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
